name: io.github.tonyyang0504/vinted_pro-mcp
description: Vinted Pro (ecommerce channels): me, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VINTED_PRO_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access key: the part BEFORE the comma of the access token generated in the Vinted Pro Integrations Portal (tokens are shown only once; production and dev mode have separate tokens); sent as X-Vpi-Access-Key.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VINTED_PRO_SIGNING_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Signing key: the part AFTER the comma of the same access token. Signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over '<unix seconds>.<METHOD>.<path+query>.<access key>.<body>', sent as X-Vpi-Hmac-Sha256: t=<ts>,v1=<hash>); never sent on the wire.
